The iPhone 14 and iPhone 14 Plus feature a 6.1-inch (15cm) and 6.7-inch (17cm) display, improvements to the rear-facing camera, and satellite connectivity for contacting emergency services. [[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPhone_14#cite_note-Apple_PR_2022-11-10-11)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPhone_14#cite_note-Leswing,_CNBC_2022-11-10-12) The iPhone 14 was made available on September 16, 2022,[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPhone_14#cite_note-13) and the iPhone 14 Plus was made available on October 7, 2022. [[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPhone_14#cite_note-official-8)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPhone_14#cite_note-14) Pre-orders for the iPhone 14 and iPhone 14 Plus began on September 9, 2022. Instead, Apple returned to a larger model with the iPhone 14 Plus. The iPhone 14 and 14 Plus are the last standard iPhones to feature the static notch, as the [iPhone 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPhone_15) series and later feature the Dynamic Island (except the [iPhone 16e](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPhone_16e) and [iPhone 17e](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPhone_17e), which continued to feature the static notch for cost-saving measures).
